inputs.source_scope: Comprehensive Lake Powell / Glen Canyon Dam operational knowledge base: governing operating plans and Records of Decision, near-term and long-term operations, drought response and contingency agreements, EIS and technical appendices, infrastructure and hydropower constraints, storage/sedimentation, hydrology and CRSS modeling, and directly operational environmental requirements. Real deep source discovery targeting broad, well-justified coverage (50-60+ sources) across official USBR/EIS/technical-appendix documents and relevant peer-reviewed/technical research.

notes: Rerun of Stages 4-6 for Lake Powell. Stages 1-3 (source acquisition, evidence extraction, knowledge consolidation) were copied unchanged from run lake_powell_20260729_kb, with paths and run_id repointed to this run; their stage summaries describe work performed on 2026-07-29. Stage 4 was redone from scratch: candidate relationships were screened across all 442 EUs (30 candidates recorded in 04_synthesis/candidate_screening.jsonl), and all 19 Synthesis Cards were written after rereading the cited source passages (evidence_depth source_checked_with_direct_quote). Stage 5 rebuilt 542 index records and reran the same 8-question benchmark. Stage 6 rewrote the report with 32 claims, each tagged inline and mapped in claim_evidence_map.jsonl. Known Stage 1-3 limitations are not addressed in this run: sampled extraction of 9 large documents, 3 access-blocked sources marked usable (OFF-033, OFF-034, RES-023), and two EU quotes that do not match their sources verbatim (EU-LP-OFF-006-12, EU-LP-OFF-023-06).
